destination.title: Where are you going?
destination.hint: Search for a city or region. Add up to three for a multi-stop trip.
destination.label: Destination
destination.tooShort: Type at least two letters, then search.
destination.required: Pick at least one destination from the search results.
destination.failed: Search is unavailable right now. Please try again.
destination.noResults: No places found. Try another spelling or a nearby city.

dates.title: When, and for how long?
dates.hint: Exact dates give you a weather forecast and calendar export. You can add dates later.
dates.missing: Choose a start and an end date.
dates.past: The trip cannot start in the past.
dates.order: The end date must be on or after the start date.
dates.length: A trip can be 1 to {{max}} days.
dates.split: The days per destination must add up to {{total}}, with at least one each.
dates.byDatesHint: I know when I am going.
dates.splitLegend: Days in each destination ({{total}} in total)

travelers.title: Who is travelling?

partyHint.family: Adults with children: shorter days, kid-friendly stops.

travelers.familyNeedsChild: A family trip includes at least one child.
travelers.friendsNeedTwo: A group of friends is at least two adults.

budget.title: What is your budget?
budget.hint: Costs are estimates for the whole group, in the currency you choose.

levelHint.budget: Free sights, street food, simple stays.
levelHint.moderate: A mix of paid sights and good local restaurants.

budget.amountHint: For the whole trip. Used for the budget meter.
budget.amountPositive: Enter an amount above zero, or leave it empty.

interests.title: What do you enjoy?
interests.hint: Pick as many as you like.

pace.title: How full should each day be?

hint.relaxed: About 3 stops a day, with long breaks.
hint.packed: 6 or more stops a day, early starts.

constraints.title: Anything we should know?
constraints.hint: All optional. The plan respects these needs.
constraints.mustSeePlaceholder: One per line, for example Belém Tower
constraints.tooLong: One of the entries is too long.

review.title: Review your trip
review.hint: Check the answers, then let Tripwise build the plan.
review.aiNote: The AI suggests places; every one is checked against OpenStreetMap before it is shown. Times and costs are estimates.
review.invalid: Some answers are missing. Go back and check each step.
review.limit: Your plan's trip limit is reached. Delete a trip or upgrade to Pro.
review.failed: The trip could not be saved. Please try again.
